title: Eight Sleep button
description: A plain, confident filled button: primary-coloured (black on light, white on dark), softly rounded (half the theme radius), medium-weight 18px label, an optional icon after it. Dims a touch on hover in 0.2s.
notes: primary-coloured: inside a dark-scoped section it turns white with ink text, like the original's buttons on photos
name: eightsleep-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: size
props.description: md: 52px tall (section CTAs) · lg: 57px tall (hero and photo CTAs)

props.name: icon
props.description: small icon after the label (e.g. a play circle)
